title: Wonder Woman Design Placemat Isn’t So Easy to Clean
text:
Wonder Woman Design Placemat Isn’t So Easy to Clean. This BUMKINS DC COMICS SILICON COLORING PLACEMAT (WONDER WOMAN), which is recommended for ages 3 and up, seems rather adult for a 3-year-old. However, it surely doesn’t hurt to introduce little girls early to female superheroes, because there aren’t a whole lot of them.

The box says that the 100% silicone placemat is easy to clean with soap and water, but that’s a bit misleading. The full care instructions read as follows: “Wash before first use. Wash after coloring, before placing food on mat. Some food items may cause staining. For best results, clean immediately after use. Wash with warm soapy water or in the dishwasher. Dishwasher safe on top rack only (up to 350 degrees F.). Do not use abrasive products for cleaning. Keep away from sharpobjects. Store in a cool dry place.”

product_metadata.title: Bumkins Reusable Silicone Coloring Placemat, DC Comics, Wonder Woman
features: Easy to clean with soap and water
description: Keep kids entertained, and reduce table mess, with a Bumkins Silicone Coloring Placemat. Made from 100% food grade silicone, little ones can unleash their creativity, then wash and reuse for a new masterpiece at each meal. Lightweight and portable, simply roll them up and toss into the diaper bag to use at restaurants or Grandma's house. Third party safety tested; BPA, PVC, vinyl, phthalate and lead free.
